objective: Resolve whether Palmer LTER colony_code values correspond to persistent physical breeding subcolonies, independently of the v1 demographic covariance result.
allowed_evidence: published colony maps and numbered-colony tables
Palmer LTER or EDI metadata and spatial products
georeferenced GIS polygons, centroids, orthomosaics or historical survey maps
documented code renames, splits or merges from source custodians or archival documentation
prohibited_evidence_for_identity_matchin: post-outcome demographic similarity used to choose aliases

confidence_grades.B: documented rename, split or merge anchored to a known historical physical footprint
confidence_grades.C: unresolved or inferential; not eligible for confirmatory identity assignment

analysis_policy.sensitivity_identity_set: grades A+B, preserving documented split/merge structure
analysis_policy.missing_code_years: must not be converted to zero unless the source explicitly documents true zero occupancy for that physical unit

required_outputs_before_next_model: frozen crosswalk table with evidence for every assignment
mapped physical-unit coordinates or polygons for eligible units
coverage summary by island and year
next_analysis_boundary: Do not freeze or run the distance-conditioned same-island model until crosswalk coverage and distance-range overlap are known. The next model must distinguish geographic distance from same-island membership and must be specified before demographic outcomes are re-opened under the resolved physical-unit identities.
